entities.name: Oriq
entities.description: A group of mages on Arcavios who study forbidden war magic, almost exclusively warlocks.

entities.name: Dawnhart
entities.description: A coven of mostly green and white-aligned warlocks following primordial, pagan traditions on Innistrad.

entities.name: Ghrin-Danu
entities.description: A god with whom members of the Dawnhart coven seem to have made a pact.

entities.name: Coiled One
entities.description: An entity some Dawnhart witches took to worshiping.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: Angel whose death led the Dawnhart to organize large festivities.

entities.name: Rowan Kenrith
entities.description: A planeswalker whose biological mother was a warlock.

entities.name: Will Kenrith
entities.description: A planeswalker whose biological mother was a warlock.

events.summary: After Avacyn's death, the Dawnhart took to organizing large festivities to beat back the darkness.
events.quote: After Avacyn 's death, they have taken to organizing large festivities, hoping to beat back the darkness and lengthen the days.

events.summary: Some Dawnhart took to worshiping the Coiled One, becoming a threat to other members of the coven.
events.quote: Some took to worshiping the Coiled One , becoming a threat to even other members of the coven.

relations.note: members seem to have made a pact with the god
relations.quote: Members of the coven seem to have made a pact with a god called Ghrin-Danu .
